CodeBehindForm
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub AltaModelo()
QueNumMod = Forms![Proceso]![Modelo]

Me.RecordsetClone.FindFirst "[nummod] = '" & Me![QueNumMod] & "'"
    Me.Bookmark = Me.RecordsetClone.Bookmark
 If Me!QueNumMod = Me!NumMod Then
   
     GoTo ByeBye
 
 End If

 
MsgBox "El modelo " & QueNumMod & " no esta dado de alta en el sistema de INVENTARIOS. Se dara de alta en este momento.", , "ALTA MODELO"

Dim Dbs As Database
Dim Almac, UltMod As Recordset
Dim UltIdMod As Integer

Set Dbs = CurrentDb
Dbs.Execute "INSERT INTO IPT_Modelos (NumMod,IdOrdenes) VALUES ('" & QueNumMod & "','" & Forms![Proceso]![IdOrdenes] & "')"

Set Almac = Dbs.OpenRecordset("SELECT IdIPT_Almacenes FROM IPT_Almacenes")
Set UltMod = Dbs.OpenRecordset("SELECT Max(IdIPT_Modelos) AS Ult FROM IPT_Modelos")
 UltIdMod = UltMod!ult
With Almac
        .MoveLast
        .MoveFirst

        Do While Not .EOF
             DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acNewRec
            IdIPT_Modelos = UltIdMod
            IdIPT_Almacenes = ![IdIPT_Almacenes]
            .MoveNext

        Loop

        .Close
    End With
    
Dbs.Close


MsgBox "Se dio de alta el Modelo con exito. Ahora solo debes de clasificarlo", vbInformation, "LISTO"

DoCmd.OpenForm "IPT_Modelos", , , "[IdIPT_Modelos]=" & UltIdMod
 
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![QueModelo].Visible = False
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![Bloq].Visible = False
'Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdOrdenes] = Forms![Proceso]![IdOrdenes]
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdEmpresas] = Forms![Proceso]![IdEmpresas]
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdEtiquetasM] = Forms![Proceso]![IdEtiquetasM]
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdClientes] = Forms![Proceso]![IdClientes]
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdIPT_TIpoPiezas] = 1

Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdIPT_Generos].SetFocus


Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdOrdenes].Enabled = False
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdEmpresas].Enabled = False
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdEtiquetasM].Enabled = False
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdClientes].Enabled = False
Forms![IPT_Modelos]![IdIPT_TIpoPiezas].Enabled = False



ByeBye:
End Sub



Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
Call AltaModelo
DoCmd.Close acForm, "IPT_VerifMod"
End Sub
